name: build-tutorials
description: Walks you through building an app the way its decisions were made — a paint-by-numbers tutorial generated from a real repository. Part of the repo-tour suite.

commands.title: Build Tutorials: Copy the files that aren’t taught

buildTutorials.repoTourPath.description: Path to the repo-tour checkout, relative to the extension or absolute. repo-tour supplies the core engine (extraction, digest, the LLM layer, skins) that this extension loads at run time. Machine-scoped on purpose: this path is dynamically imported and its top-level code runs in the extension host, so a repository must not be able to set it from its own .vscode/settings.json.

buildTutorials.llmProvider.description: Which LLM provider repo-tour's interpret stage asks for each step's why and its roads-not-taken (spec §4.3). The default runs the local claude CLI — a subscription tool, not an API key.

buildTutorials.llmModel.description: Model name passed to the provider. Empty uses repo-tour's own recommended default (its interpret module's DEFAULT_MODEL export) read at run time, so this setting never hardcodes a copy that can drift out of sync with repo-tour.

buildTutorials.commitPerStep.description: Commit each completed step in the tutorial folder, with the message “<ordinal>: <question> — <the option the author chose>”. The commits are yours: they use that folder’s own git identity, and if none is configured no commit is made and the panel says so rather than inventing an author.

buildTutorials.tutorModel.description: Model the TUTOR asks, kept separate from buildTutorials.llmModel on purpose. The build model is chosen for what interpreting a whole repository costs, once, in the background; the tutor is one question from one person at the moment they are stuck. Empty means the provider’s strongest model rather than its default — the right way round for the only place a wrong answer is read by someone already confused.

buildTutorials.tutorTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a tutor answer before giving up. A timeout is reported as a reply in the panel, never as a spinner that does not end.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The walk opens automatically for any folder containing .repo-tour/build/plan.json, and rendering it loads repo-tour's core by dynamic import. Neither should happen in a workspace you have not trusted.
